plainTranslation: Drive faces control head-on. The Mars person wants to act now; the Saturn person wants to wait and plan. Push-pull over pace, ambition, and authority, each accusing the other of the opposite flaw. Failure mode: a stalemate of force against resistance. Meet in the middle; you each hold what the other lacks.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
